scripts.title: Simple Auto Collect Coins [OP!]
scripts.script:
local _0x1234 = game:GetService("Workspace").CoinFolder
local _0x5678 = game.Players.LocalPlayer.Character.HumanoidRootPart
local _0x9abc = {["TouchTransmitter"] = true}

local function _0xdef0()
    while wait() do
        for _0x1, _0x2 in pairs(_0x1234:GetDescendants()) do
            if _0x9abc[_0x2.ClassName] then
                local _0x3 = _0x2.Parent
                for _0x4 = 0, 1 do
                    firetouchinterest(_0x5678, _0x3, _0x4)
                end
            end
        end
    end
end

_0xdef0()
